name: Examine one specific claim (English)

labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

## Claim and source

Which single statement are you examining? Include a GitHub link, section,
and commit SHA.

## Method and independence

What did you check yourself? Distinguish reading sources, auditing a
record, reproducing a numerical result, and proving a mathematical claim.
Which programs, versions, and platform did you use? Describe any AI
assistance and any prior involvement in the result under review.

## Observed result

What did you find? Link a minimal calculation, counterexample, or
reproduction steps and relevant output. Negative or incomplete findings
are helpful too.

## Interpretation and limits

What follows from your examination, and what remains unchecked? Is there
a simpler explanation? What observation would falsify your interpretation?

## Proposed resolution

What bounded correction, clarification, or further examination would help?
A proposal for a new experiment does not authorize its execution.
